rationale: With only 27 minutes to close, COGT has already made its large move (gapped up 3.52% and ran to $35.13 intraday), and price is now consolidating in a tight range around $32.98 — well below the session high and below both VWAP ($33.21) and the 9-EMA ($33.14), suggesting the momentum has faded.
